description: Add centralized language constraint injection system to all AI agents. Agents will automatically adapt their output language based on OUTPUT_LANGUAGE configuration from .auto-claude/.env.
workflow_rationale: This is a new feature that adds language configuration capability to the existing agent system. The implementation uses a centralized injection approach that adds language constraints at runtime without modifying core agent logic or tools. The 'sandwich strategy' (injection at both prompt start and end) ensures maximum effectiveness.

phases.name: Core Language Module
phases.description: Create the core/language.py module with language constraint injection logic. This is the foundation that all other phases depend on.

verification.command: cd apps/backend && python -c "from core.language import inject_language_constraint; result = inject_language_constraint('test prompt', 'en'); print('OK' if 'target_language' in result and 'en' in result else 'FAIL')"
cd apps/backend && python -c "from core.language import get_output_language; lang = get_output_language(); print(lang)"

subtasks.description: Implement sandwich strategy (inject at both prompt start and end)

verification.command: cd apps/backend && python -c "from core.language import inject_language_constraint; result = inject_language_constraint('test', 'zh'); print('OK' if result.count('target_language') == 2 else 'FAIL')"

phases.name: Session Integration
phases.description: Integrate language constraint injection into run_agent_session() in agents/session.py. This ensures all agent sessions receive language constraints.

subtasks.description: Import and call inject_language_constraint() in run_agent_session()

verification.command: cd apps/backend && python -c "import ast; tree = ast.parse(open('agents/session.py').read()); imports = [node.names[0].name for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == 'core.language']; print('OK' if 'inject_language_constraint' in imports else 'FAIL')"

subtasks.description: Inject language constraints before client.query() call

verification.instructions: Review agents/session.py around line 488. Verify that message is modified by inject_language_constraint() before the await client.query(message) call.

phases.name: Client Integration
phases.description: Inject global language constraint into create_client() base_prompt in core/client.py. This ensures SDK-level language coverage.

subtasks.description: Inject language constraints into base_prompt construction

verification.instructions: Review core/client.py around lines 892-936. Verify that language constraint is appended to base_prompt after CLAUDE.md content.

subtasks.notes: Imported get_output_language and inject_language_constraint from core.language module. Added injection after CLAUDE.md content (line 938-943) and added print statement to show configured language. Commit: f10be089

phases.name: Configuration Documentation
phases.description: Document OUTPUT_LANGUAGE variable in .env.example and add default configuration.

phases.name: Integration Testing
phases.description: Verify end-to-end language constraint functionality across all agents.

verification.instructions: 1. Ensure OUTPUT_LANGUAGE=en is set in .auto-claude/.env. 2. Run a simple agent session. 3. Verify output is in English.
1. Set OUTPUT_LANGUAGE=zh in .auto-claude/.env. 2. Run a simple agent session. 3. Verify output is in Chinese without English mixing.

subtasks.description: Test missing OUTPUT_LANGUAGE defaults to English

verification.instructions: 1. Remove or comment out OUTPUT_LANGUAGE in .auto-claude/.env. 2. Run a simple agent session. 3. Verify output defaults to English and warning is logged.

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-1-core-module and modify different files (client.py vs .env files)

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution recommended - phases have tight dependencies

acceptance_criteria: inject_language_constraint() adds constraints at both prompt start AND end
create_client() includes global language constraint in base_prompt
Agents respond in configured language (en, zh, fr, etc.)
Missing OUTPUT_LANGUAGE defaults to English with logged warning
No regression in existing agent functionality

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk requires unit tests for core functionality and integration tests for injection points. Language constraint effectiveness requires manual verification with actual AI agents. No security scan needed as no auth/data handling changes. Staging deployment not needed for backend-only configuration change.
